title: Gujarat Consumer Commission: Paying Members of Sports Clubs Are Consumers Under the Act
court: Gujarat State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
case_name: Manubhai C. Shah v. Surat District Cricket Association & Ors.
card_summary: The State Commission set aside a district forum order dismissing a lifetime member's complaint against the Surat District Cricket Association on maintainability alone. It held that a member paying fees for sports and recreational facilities is a consumer availing a service, not merely a cardholder. The complaint over termination of his membership was remanded for a decision on merits.
card_tip: Clubs and associations cannot get a paying member's complaint thrown out at the threshold by arguing he is not a consumer; expect disputes over membership termination and fees to be heard on merits.
verification_notes: Case name, appeal number and bench (I.D. Patel and Dr. J.G. Mecwan) confirmed across Bar and Bench and LawChakra reports, both dated 22 October 2026; neither report states the date the order was actually pronounced, so the report date is used as the decision date.
